summary: Accept numeric values without silently converting text.
documentation: Number.isFinite returns true only when its argument has type number and is neither positive infinity, negative infinity nor NaN. It does not coerce strings, booleans or null.
returns: A boolean indicating whether the value is a finite number.
caution: The global isFinite function performs coercion. Number.isFinite deliberately does not.
scenarios: Validate numeric measurements before plotting them.
Reject text that arrived in a numeric import column.
Check calculations before showing a customer-facing total.
title: Keep actual numeric readings
problem: Given a list of JSON values, return only finite numbers in their original order. Numeric strings, booleans and null must not be accepted.
goal: Use Number.isFinite() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
